Name: Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Author: Microsoft - support@microsoft.com
Description:
The Salesforce Marketing Cloud solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests audit and security events from the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Audit Trail API through the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). It provides visibility into user activity, system changes, login attempts, and authentication outcomes. For API details, see https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud/references/mc_rest_audit?meta=Summary.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:
- Microsoft Sentinel
- Azure Monitor Logs
- Data Collection Rules (DCR)
- Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)

Dependencies:
- A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Installed Package
- Data Tracking Event Read permission
- Tenant-specific REST and authentication base URLs
